title: 第24章 巫师语认证
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
收回目光，伊森抬脚朝教学楼外走去。

    考试院的位置，在教学区最深处。

    穿过教学区的主干道，绕过一座巨大的石碑，前方出现一片低矮的建筑群。

    和教学区那些高耸的建筑不同，这里的建筑最高不过两层，通体由灰黑色的石材砌成，表面没有任何装饰，只有每栋建筑门口挂着的牌子，以及门楣上方流转的符文光芒。

    伊森放慢脚步，目光扫过那些牌子。

    “认证大厅”

    “考核室”

    “成绩登记处”

    “档案室”

    ......

    他的目光落在“认证大厅”那块牌子上。

    那是一栋单层建筑，门比其他建筑宽得多，足以容纳四五个人并行。

    门半开着，能看见里面有微弱的光芒透出。

    伊森推门而入。

    里面的空间比外面看着要大得多。

    穹顶高悬，至少有三层楼那么高。

    四周墙壁上嵌着散发着柔和白光的水晶晶石，将整个大厅照得如同白昼。

    正对门口是一条宽阔的通道，通道两侧排列着十几个窗口。

    每个窗口都是封闭的，只留下一个半人高的拱形开口，开口处有符文光芒流转。

    此刻大厅里人不多。

    几个穿着灰袍的身影分散在各个窗口前，有的低着头填写什么，有的把骨牌递进窗口，有的接过窗口递出来的东西转身离开。

    伊森的目光扫过那些窗口上方的牌子。

    “巫师语认证”

    “符文基础认证”

    “材料辨识认证”

    ......

    他走到“巫师语认证”那个窗口前。

    窗口后面坐着一个穿着深灰色袍子的中年女人。她面容普通，神情淡漠，手里握着一支羽毛笔，正对着一本册子写写画画。

    听到脚步声，女人抬起头，目光在伊森身上扫了一眼。

    “认证？”

    “是。”伊森点点头，从怀里取出骨牌，递进窗口。

    女人接过骨牌，随手按在桌面上一个凹槽里。

    桌面亮起淡蓝色的光芒，几息后，光芒消散。

    女人低头看了一眼，挑了挑眉。

    “巫师语全部章节学完了？”

    “是。”

    女人重新打量了伊森一眼，那目光里带着一丝审视，还有一丝说不清道不明的东西。
content_en:
Withdrawing his gaze, Ethan walked towards the outside of the teaching building.

    The location of the examination hall is at the deepest part of the teaching area.

    Passing through the main road of the teaching area, bypassing a huge stone monument, a group of low buildings appeared in front.

    Different from the towering buildings in the teaching area, the buildings here only have two floors at most, and are made entirely of gray-black stone. There is no decoration on the surface, except for the sign hanging at the door of each building and the rune light flowing above the lintel.

    Ethan slowed down and scanned the signs.

    "Certification Hall"

    "Assessment Room"

    "Registration Office"

    "Archives"

    ...

    His eyes fell on the "Certification Hall" sign.

    It was a single-story building with doors much wider than other buildings, enough to accommodate four or five people abreast.

    The door was ajar, and a faint light could be seen coming from inside.

    Ethan pushed open the door and entered.

    The space inside is much larger than it looks from the outside.

    The dome hangs high, at least as high as three stories.

    The surrounding walls are embedded with crystal spar that emit soft white light, illuminating the entire hall like daylight.

    Directly opposite the door is a wide passage with more than a dozen windows lined up on both sides of the passage.

    Each window is closed, leaving only an arched opening half a person's height, with runes of light flowing through the opening.

    There weren't many people in the hall at the moment.

    Several figures in gray robes were scattered in front of various windows. Some lowered their heads to fill in something, some handed the dominoes into the window, and some took what was handed out from the window and turned around to leave.

    Ethan's eyes scanned the signs above the windows.

    "Wizard Language Certification"

    "Rune Basics Certification"

    "Material Identification Certification"

    ...

    He walked to the "Wizard Language Authentication" window.

    Behind the window sat a middle-aged woman wearing a dark gray robe. She has an ordinary face and an indifferent expression. She holds a quill in her hand and is writing and drawing on a book.

    Hearing the footsteps, the woman raised her head and glanced at Ethan.

    "Certification?"

    "Yes." Ethan nodded, took out the dominoes from his arms and handed them through the window.

    The woman took the domino and pressed it into a groove on the table.

    The tabletop lit up with a light blue light, and after a few breaths, the light dissipated.

    The woman glanced down and raised her eyebrows.

    "Have you finished learning all the chapters of Wizarding Language?"

    "Yes."

    The woman looked at Ethan again, with a trace of scrutiny in her gaze, and something inexplicable.
